business_profile.address: Osabu Link, HSE 9, GW-063-1043 Adenta, Accra, Ghana
business_profile.opening_hours: Support: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm (Ghana time). Delivery courier hours may vary.

payment_methods.label: Cash on delivery
payment_methods.instructions: Pay the courier in cash when your order arrives. Confirm the total (products + delivery) before handover.

payment_methods.label: Mobile Money
payment_methods.instructions: After order confirmation, a secure Paystack link is sent in chat for MTN MoMo and other networks. Never share your PIN or OTP in chat.

payment_methods.label: Card (Paystack)
payment_methods.instructions: After order confirmation, a secure Paystack card checkout link is sent in chat. Never send card numbers in WhatsApp.

payment_methods.label: Bank transfer
payment_methods.instructions: Ask for staff confirmation — they will share approved account details and confirm payment.

policies.delivery: We deliver across Ghana. Standard shipping is GH₵40 per order. Orders are typically processed in 1–2 business days; delivery usually takes 2–5 business days depending on location. Accra and major cities are usually faster.
policies.returns: Contact us within 14 days of delivery. Unopened items in original packaging may qualify for return or exchange. Opened oral care products generally cannot be returned for hygiene reasons unless damaged, defective, or incorrect. Email hello@gelosglobal.com with your order number and photos if needed.
policies.privacy: We use your name, phone, and delivery details only to fulfil WhatsApp orders and customer support. Contact hello@gelosglobal.com for privacy questions.

faqs.question: Where is Gelos located?
faqs.answer: Osabu Link, HSE 9, GW-063-1043 Adenta, Accra, Ghana.

faqs.question: How much is delivery?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery across Ghana is GH₵40 per order. Ask staff if your area needs a special courier quote.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery, Mobile Money, and card via a secure Paystack link sent after you confirm your order. Never share PINs, OTPs, or full card details in chat.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Share your order number and delivery city with support. We aim to reply within one business day (Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm).

faqs.question: Can I speak to a person?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask for a staff handoff anytime and a team member will continue the chat.

faqs.question: How do I confirm my order?
faqs.answer: After you review the order summary, type exactly: CONFIRM ORDER
